evals.name: map-replacement-request
evals.prompt: Replace every repeated array find with a Map because it is O(1).
evals.expected_output: The skill requires a representative workload and profile, preserves ordering and uniqueness semantics, and keeps the current implementation when gains are within noise.
assertions: Checks Map construction and memory cost

evals.name: tail-regression
evals.prompt: The new cache improves average latency by 12 percent but worsens p99 and memory. Ship it.
evals.expected_output: The decision is based on declared required metrics and rejects the change when p99 or memory violates them.
assertions: Does not optimize average latency alone
Reports the change as rejected or inconclusive

evals.name: measured-hot-loop
evals.prompt: A profile shows route lookup dominates a 10,000-route workload. Compare the current scan with an index and implement only if it wins.
evals.expected_output: A controlled before-and-after comparison checks route precedence, canonicalization, memory, crossover size, and adds a regression guard.
assertions: Adds a noise-aware guard only after a material win
